arguments.prompt: Revise the existing Spend Review app in withAutograph/arrusted-development into one authenticated, persistent app. Start app content from historical source d186c659629430e1d6c8dce9575cdc30bdc20087 (the agreed pre-revision Spend Review baseline), using current repository foundations. Requesters submit purchases; reviewers decide them, and cannot approve their own requests. Retire the synthetic product demo and reset flow; permit authenticated local and Preview use. Use ordinary app module names, cursor-paginated queues and audit history, and package only the selected immutable backend release. Builder owns the schema, application, database preparation, authenticated validation, working Preview and a new reviewable draft PR. Verify role enforcement and revocation, tenant isolation, forged-scope rejection, idempotent submissions, concurrent decisions, complete audit pagination, persistence across reload/restart/new Preview deployment, and populated upgrade plus failed-upgrade recovery. Keep the restricted one-organization production pilot and separate operator approval/provider activation gates. Use the existing Vercel-managed Neon connection; no new Neon management connection or ambient provider keys. Compare the resulting change to the manual implementation only after generation. Do not activate production.
